clue.text: Passionate relationship, nothing connected with business

parts.note: love is zero in tennis scoring, so nothing gives LOVE
an affair is a matter or piece of business, as in 'that's my affair'

explanation.surface: A romance with no strings attached to anyone's work life.
explanation.walkthrough: 'connected with' simply joins the two pieces. Business here is the 'affair' of 'state affairs', not commerce.
explanation.definitionFit: A romantic or sexual liaison between two people is the standard meaning of the phrase.

clue.text: Bird left Noah's refuge

parts.note: the ark was the boat Noah built to survive the Flood

explanation.surface: A bird flew off from the ark.
explanation.definitionFit: The skylark is a familiar songbird.

clue.text: As far as work goes, he's not impressed

definitions.text: As far as work goes, he's not impressed

parts.words: As far as work goes, he's not impressed
parts.note: impressed is read as press-ganged into service; someone who offers to work freely was never forced into it

explanation.surface: A worker shrugs, unmoved by the job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not impressed' looks like 'unmoved', but it means not conscripted by the press gang, the old naval practice of forcing men into service.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who offers their labour freely, unpaid and unforced, rather than being conscripted.

clue.text: A range of hearing

parts.note: the Urals are the mountain range dividing Europe from Asia

explanation.surface: Something describing the span of sounds a person can hear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'range' seems to belong with hearing, as in hearing range, but it is the Ural mountains.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective relates to the ear and the sense of sound perception.

clue.text: Hurry across bridge as short-cut

parts.note: to fly is to rush or move very fast
over can mean across, as in 'over the road'

explanation.surface: Dashing over a bridge to save time on the journey.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain this is a road bridge carrying traffic over another road or junction.
explanation.definitionFit: A road raised on a bridge over a junction lets traffic bypass it, a kind of shortcut.

clue.text: Stupidly is under-protected

indicators.note: stupidly suggests the letters of is under are muddled into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone foolishly has too little cover.
explanation.walkthrough: The hyphen in 'under-protected' hides the join between the anagram fodder 'is under' and the definition 'protected'.
explanation.definitionFit: Having a policy against loss means being covered or safeguarded financially.

clue.text: Vessel displays royal monogram we inscribed

indicators.note: inscribed means written within, so the word we goes inside the monogram

parts.note: ER, for Elizabeth Regina, is the cipher of Queen Elizabeth

explanation.surface: A piece of plate engraved with the royal cipher and the word 'we'.
explanation.definitionFit: A jug or large pitcher for water is a type of container.

clue.text: She's a survivor

parts.note: read as a woman who has outlived her husband, rather than a tough person

explanation.surface: Praise for a resilient woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'survivor' suggests toughness; here it means one who survives a spouse.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman whose husband has died and who has not remarried.

clue.text: Sign of king's embarrassment, getting a wonderful hand?

definitions.meaning: a blush on a monarch's face would be a regal reddening
in poker the ace-high straight in one suit is the best possible hand

explanation.walkthrough: The first sense is a pun: flush meaning a blush, royal because the king has it.
explanation.definitionFit: In poker the top straight of one suit beats everything; punningly, a monarch's red face.

clue.text: Ambassador to notice a revolutionary giving pain

parts.note: HE, His Excellency, is the title of an ambassador
an ad is a notice or advertisement
Che Guevara is the crossword's stock revolutionary

explanation.surface: An envoy and a rebel bringing each other trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: An ache in the head is a common pain; the word also means a nagging problem.

clue.text: Powerful man is an aid to going straight

definitions.meaning: a sovereign or leader who governs
a measuring stick for drawing straight lines

explanation.walkthrough: 'going straight' suggests reforming a criminal, but it is drawing a straight line.
explanation.definitionFit: A monarch governs; a graduated straight edge guides a pencil in a line.

clue.text: Dry eyes at disaster just recently

indicators.note: disaster signals that the letters of dry eyes at are wrecked into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone stays tearless in the face of calamity.
explanation.definitionFit: The day before today is a time only lately past.

clue.text: Well off, including partner

parts.note: inc. is the abbreviation for including or inclusive
a lover is a romantic partner

explanation.surface: Marrying someone rich brings comfort.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase comes from cattle grazing in a rich clover field.
explanation.definitionFit: Living in comfort and plenty, prosperous.

clue.text: Fastener to function well? Almost

parts.note: to do is to perform or work, as in 'that will do'

indicators.note: almost means the last letter of well is left off

explanation.surface: Asking whether a fixing works properly, nearly.
explanation.definitionFit: A wooden peg used to join two pieces of wood is a kind of fixing.

clue.text: Solid progress expected in this ship?

definitions.text: Solid progress expected in this ship?

parts.words: Solid progress expected in this ship?
parts.note: solid is read as frozen water: the vessel makes headway by smashing through ice

explanation.surface: A boast about a steady voyage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Solid progress' sounds like reliable headway; the solid is ice.
explanation.definitionFit: A ship built to cut channels through frozen seas.

clue.text: Man leaves city for another nearby

indicators.note: leaves means the word man departs from the city's name

parts.note: Manchester is a major city in north-west England
taken as written

explanation.surface: A fellow moves out of one city to live in a neighbouring one.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is a cathedral city in north-west England, about forty miles from Manchester.
explanation.definitionFit: A Cheshire city lying not far from Manchester, so a second, neighbouring city.

clue.text: Vicious predator's sign of remorse?

indicators.note: vicious suggests the letters of predator are savaged into a new order

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: A fierce hunter shows contrition, perhaps crocodile tears.
explanation.definitionFit: A single drop of weeping is a token of sorrow or regret.

clue.text: Numbering system claimed to be faulty

indicators.note: faulty means the letters of claimed are wrongly arranged and must be put in a new order

explanation.surface: A complaint that a method of counting is flawed.
explanation.definitionFit: Counting in tens is the base-ten notation in everyday use.

clue.text: For merchandise, a write off?

parts.note: write off is read as writing off for goods, sending a letter to request them

explanation.surface: Stock that has been written off as a loss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'write off' suggests cancelling a debt; read it as writing away for goods.
explanation.definitionFit: Buying goods by post from a catalogue, sending off a written request.

clue.text: Veto display of anger in intense attack

parts.note: to bar is to forbid or veto
rage is a fit of fury

explanation.surface: A furious outburst and a refusal in a heated assault.
explanation.definitionFit: Heavy concentrated artillery fire, or a torrent of criticism.

clue.text: To gripe miserably is a self-indulgence

indicators.note: miserably signals that the letters of to gripe are wretchedly jumbled

explanation.surface: Moaning about one's woes is just vanity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is a' links the anagram to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done mainly to gratify one's vanity or sense of importance.

clue.text: Kind scouts round city

indicators.note: round means the spies' letters go around the city

parts.note: scouts are those sent ahead to spy, so spies
EC is the postcode for the City of London

explanation.surface: Boy scouts surrounding an urban area.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Kind' looks like an adjective meaning nice; it is a noun meaning sort.
explanation.definitionFit: A sort or type, as in a biological class of organisms.

clue.text: Member of family has

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'Member of family has (7)' is cut short: the wordplay after 'has' (likely a STEPS ON reading) is missing and no scan or search gives the rest.

clue.text: Creature from the Orient?

parts.note: read as an animal hailing from an eastern country, though the beast in question is actually native to Africa

explanation.surface: An animal from the Far East.
explanation.walkthrough: The animal is an African antelope; the pun splits its name into the compass letter for east and a word for country.
explanation.definitionFit: A large African antelope with spiral horns is an animal.

clue.text: Gulf where sailor joins unknown ship

parts.note: AB, able-bodied seaman, is a sailor
Y is an algebraic unknown
SS stands for steamship

explanation.surface: A seaman boards a mystery vessel in a bay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Gulf' suggests a bay at sea; it means a chasm.
explanation.definitionFit: A deep chasm or bottomless pit is a vast gap.

clue.text: Flood being ended, wolf returns

parts.note: something over is finished

indicators.note: returns means the word wolf is read backwards

explanation.surface: After a deluge, a wolf comes back.
explanation.definitionFit: To spill beyond the edges is to inundate.

clue.text: Nearly neglect smithy

indicators.note: nearly means the last letter is dropped from the synonym

parts.note: to forget something is to neglect it

explanation.surface: Almost overlooking the blacksmith's workshop.
explanation.definitionFit: A blacksmith's workshop with its furnace is the same thing.

clue.text: Jog along and run into child

indicators.note: into means the run goes inside the child

parts.note: a tot is a small child
R is the cricket abbreviation for a run

explanation.surface: Bumping into a small child while out jogging.
explanation.definitionFit: To move at a gentle running pace.

clue.text: York-based maker of musical instruments

indicators.note: maker of suggests the letters of York-based are used to make something new

explanation.surface: A firm in York that builds instruments.
explanation.walkthrough: 'maker of' reads as a manufacturer; it signals the letters are made into something else.
explanation.definitionFit: Pianos, synthesisers and organs played with keys are instruments.

clue.text: Speed trap operates in either direction

indicators.note: reading the same forwards and backwards, the letters work either way

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A police speed camera that catches traffic both ways.
explanation.definitionFit: Police use radio-wave detection guns to catch speeding drivers.

clue.text: Wine goes up

explanation.walkthrough: The second sense is loose in tense: the answer is the past form, went up.
explanation.definitionFit: A pink wine shares its spelling with the past tense of ascend.

clue.text: It's general knowledge, so pretence is out

indicators.note: out means the letters of so pretence are disordered and rearranged

explanation.surface: The pretence is exposed, now everyone knows.
explanation.definitionFit: Something nominally confidential that is widely known.
